answer: A farm of 93 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in harbor, queued in karst, and onyx publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 16 identities per epoch. A farm of 2778 identities would post 1442 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
